Get requested part of calculated digest. Entire digest value is kept in the context up to next call

Description:
Get requested part of calculated digest. Entire digest value is kept in the context up to next call
Start(), therefore any its part can be extracted again or verified. If more data is requested
than available, only the calculated digest will be written to out. Note: in case truncation
Length is 0, no data is written to out and 0 is returned. Note: If truncation is requested, this
function shall not modify bits of the output buffer beyond the left-most truncationLength bits!
